purpose: Initial TL3 maturation/integration candidates for the core technology table. These values express agreed design direction and are not yet production or combat-consumer authority.
scope: Computing, Sensors/EW, Power, Shields, Armor, and held weapon-penetration state. TL3 weapon-family, PDS, STL/FTL, and broader Auxiliary progression remain deliberately incomplete.

tacticalComputer.notes: Evasive Compensation offsets only the ship's own Evasive-posture firing penalty to a minimum residual penalty of zero; excess compensation never becomes a positive accuracy bonus.

sensor.notes: High Active normalizes the current overload-level reach as a deliberate higher-power mode without Strain; it does not automatically extend the envelope beyond 4/5.

ecm.notes: Maturation improves normal power efficiency without raising the rating ceiling.

eccm.notes: Maturation improves normal power efficiency without increasing discrimination strength or sensor reach.

powerReactor.notes: Raw Operational output remains 6 TP while the Main Reactor footprint falls from 6 to 5 Space. Condition mapping, overload, storage, auxiliary generation, and reliability receive no new benefit in this candidate.

shield.technologyRole: Mature shield integration with optional powered hardening

shieldHardener.notes: Owned by Shields TL3. Any legal installed power architecture may supply the 1 TP; no arbitrary Power-TL gate is imposed.

armor.notes: TL3 adds actual Protection while holding TL2 Integrity. This naturally exposes the AP1 breakpoint to existing family-specific APEN values.

kinetic.note: Hold TL2 Kinetic penetration candidate initially; AP1 armor now creates a natural breakpoint for broader cross-TL testing.

missile.note: No automatic TL3 penetration increase; future Missile progression should remain seeker/guidance/propulsion/payload oriented where appropriate.

deferredOutsideThisPackage: TL3 main-weapon family progression beyond held penetration references
broader TL3 Auxiliary catalog progression beyond the Shield Hardener
guardrails: Higher TL may improve capability, efficiency, footprint, integration, or operating modes rather than every primary statistic.
Sensor reach and discrimination remain separate; High Active is a visible powered mode and does not manufacture Firm outside its physical envelope.
ECM/ECCM ratings remain non-additive across redundant same-type installations.
Shield Hardener SA is a separate powered support effect and does not silently increase the primary shield generator's base Shield Armor.
Armor Protection and Armor Integrity remain separate and retain APEN counterplay.
Legacy reactors remain stackable where normal construction rules permit; TL3 miniaturization competes through real Space opportunity cost rather than anti-stacking rules.
No automatic promotion occurs from table registration alone.
